tasks.prompt: Build a complete standalone HTML Minesweeper game with a 9x9 board, 10 mines, flags, neighbor counts, restart button, first-click safety and timer.
Create a single-file calculator supporting the four basic operations, decimal entry, clear, and keyboard input.
Build a local-only to-do list with add, complete and remove operations, saving state to localStorage.
Build a stopwatch with start, pause and reset and a display that advances over time.
Create a memory matching game with a grid of face-down pairs, matching and reset.
Build an offline contact form that validates required name, email syntax and displays errors without sending data.
Write a Python command-line calculator with parseable operations and unit tests.
Build a Python CSV expense aggregator by category with missing-file handling and unit tests.
Write a Python text word-frequency tool that ignores punctuation and capitalization.
Create a Python JSON address-book utility with add, update, delete and invalid-file handling.
